summary: Verified a material official forecast-state change in the October 6 EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook. EIA raised its 4Q26 Brent forecast to $105/b, $14/b above September, and reports East Coast distillate inventories 32% below their five-year seasonal average. ORACLE treats this as stronger energy-inflation persistence, not a new realized physical outage, because EIA simultaneously assumes recovering Middle East flows. SUPERMESH-X preserves the October 1 model-input cutoff and the fact that the forecast excludes the October 2 G7 supply announcement. A separate control-plane check found the active Macro automation identity is absent from the current registry, the registered replacement is historical-disabled/absent from live inventory, and both candidate request namespaces are missing; therefore no hybrid result was fabricated.
